description: This file contains Redux action creators for product-related operations in a shopping application, including fetching all products, fetching a product by ID, fetching products by category, searching, and applying filters. It also defines related action type constants.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Dispatches an action to fetch all products from the API and handles success or failure.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Fetches a specific product by ID and dispatches corresponding actions based on success or failure.

methods.name: getProductsByCategory
methods.description: Fetches products filtered by category and dispatches success or failure actions.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query for products and dispatches corresponding actions.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies filters to product list based on filter string and dispatches success or failure actions.
